# Synthetic TS fixture

`h264-colors.ts` was generated locally with Chromium WebCodecs: four 64×64 solid-color frames at two frames per second, all keyframes. PAT, PMT, PES/PTS and TS packets were constructed by the test generator. There is no downloaded film or anime in this fixture. It intentionally contains video only; the local integration check also exercises an existing H.264/AAC episode outside the repository.
